notes: The vendor's 'portable' build is a single self-contained 'alacritty.exe'; it is installed as-is and renamed to 'alacritty.exe'.
Alacritty has no built-in updater: there is no update component, no scheduled task and nothing that replaces its own files. Update with 'scoop update alacritty-portable'.
Alacritty never registers a run-at-login entry, so nothing is added to Windows startup.
Configuration is read from '%APPDATA%\alacritty\alacritty.toml', which survives updates; use 'alacritty --config-file <path>' for a per-profile config.
